key_facts: Expediente 121/000096 = Proyecto de Ley Orgánica para el buen uso y la gobernanza de la inteligencia artificial (LOIA), XV Legislatura, a Government (organic law) bill.
As of the Congreso official amendment-deadline table updated 17 July 2026, the bill is still in the 'Todo o Totalidad' (totality amendment) phase; the 'Articulado' column is empty.
The totality-amendment deadline dates listed are 30-06-2026 and 02-09-2026, with 02-09-2026 (2 September 2026) in bold as the current active deadline (carried past the August recess).
No enmiendas a la totalidad, committee reports, debates, or votes had been formally registered/published for the bill as of mid-July 2026.
Legislative timeline: Council of Ministers approved remission 26 May 2026; presented 28 May 2026; qualified by the Mesa 8 June 2026; published in BOCG (A-97-1) 12 June 2026.
Committee of reference: Comisión de Economía, Comercio y Transformación Digital.

The bill adapts EU Regulation 2024/1689 (EU AI Act), designating AESIA, AEPD, CGPJ as supervisory authorities, defining sanctions, creating regulatory sandboxes, and mandating public-sector AI transparency and human oversight.
The original amendment deadline reported (ControlCongreso, updated 12 June 2026) was 30 June 2026 at 18:00; it was subsequently extended.
As an organic law, final passage requires an absolute majority; a totality debate, if totality amendments are filed, would occur after the September 2026 return from recess at the earliest.
